info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Cloud Deploy API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Delivery pipelines, targets, custom target types and deploy policies are configuration metadata: no release, rollout, render, deploy job, verification or automation runs, and no GKE, Cloud Run, Anthos or custom target is contacted. Pipeline conditions are not computed, and pipeline, target and policy references are stored as given. allowMissing is refused. Long-running operations complete synchronously and remain readable through operations.get/list.
info.title: Cloud Deploy (simulator catalog)
